title: Coupling-Robust Accuracy in Multiphysics Physics Informed Neural Networks via Kronecker-Preconditioned Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.23391v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer a mesh-free route to solving coupled multiphysics systems, but their accuracy degrades systematically as inter-equation coupling strengthens, and inverse-gradient-norm loss balancing alone does not reliably prevent this failure. This study explains why coupling degrades PINN training and identifies an optimizer structure that removes the dependence, replacing case-by-case tuning with a principled remedy. Through a neural tangent kernel analysis, we prove that the standard kernel's spectral radius grows as $\Omega(\gamma^2)$ with coupling strength $\gamma$, whereas block-diagonal Gauss-Newton (GN) preconditioning bounds it by the number of networks $S$, independent of $\gamma$; no diagonal preconditioner recovers this bound for any coupling type or loss weighting. translated_title: 基于Kronecker预条件优化的多物理场物理信息神经网络耦合鲁棒精度研究
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）提供了一种无网格方法来解决耦合多物理场系统，但随着方程间耦合强度的增加，其精度会系统性下降，而仅靠逆梯度范数损失平衡并不能可靠地防止这种失效。本研究解释了耦合为何会降低PINN训练性能，并确定了一种优化器结构，该结构能消除这种依赖性，用原理性解决方案取代逐案例调参。通过神经正切核分析，我们证明了标准核的谱半径随耦合强度γ按Ω(γ²)增长，而块对角高斯-牛顿（GN）预条件将其限制在网络数量S内，与γ无关；任何对角预条件器都无法在任何耦合类型或损失加权下恢复此界限。我们通过Kronecker预条件优化器SOAP结合逆梯度实现块对角GN预条件。
tldr: 本研究通过Kronecker预条件优化器（SOAP）实现块对角高斯-牛顿预条件，从理论上证明并解决了PINNs在多物理场耦合中精度随耦合强度退化的问题，提供了无需逐例调参的通用方案。
en_tdlr: This study theoretically proves and addresses the accuracy degradation of PINNs under strong multiphysics coupling by implementing block-diagonal Gauss-Newton preconditioning via the Kronecker-preconditioned optimizer SOAP, offering a general solution without case-by-case tuning.
